decisions.briefing: Markets pulled back slightly today (NASDAQ -0.8%, S&P 500 -0.5%), a neutral-to-soft session rather than a risk-on setup. While several candidates (SWKS, FPS, QRVO, KRMN, RIG, VAL, CVI, AADX) score well on RSI/MACD/SMA signals, none show the volume surge confirmation needed for high-conviction entries, so we're holding cash and existing positions rather than forcing a buy.

market_education.summary_en: Broad indices drifted lower today with the NASDAQ down 0.8% and the S&P 500 down 0.5%, a mild pullback rather than a decisive move in either direction. Momentum screens still show a cluster of stocks with bullish MACD crossovers and RSI in healthy ranges, but the absence of volume confirmation across the board suggests institutional conviction hasn't fully materialized yet. Days like this call for patience rather than chasing signals that look good on paper but lack the participation to back them up.
market_education.summary_zh: 大盤今日普遍走弱，納斯達克下跌0.8%，標普500下跌0.5%，屬溫和回調而非明確方向性走勢。動能篩選仍顯示一批股票出現MACD黃金交叉及RSI處於健康區間，但整體缺乏成交量放大確認，顯示機構資金尚未全面進場。此類日子應保持耐性，避免追逐表面訊號強勁、卻缺乏實際資金參與支持的標的。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: A price move or technical signal (like a MACD crossover) is much more trustworthy when it's accompanied by higher-than-average trading volume, because that shows real money — often institutional — is backing the move. Without a volume surge, a bullish-looking setup could just be noise that fades quickly, which is why several high-scoring candidates today were passed over.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 當價格走勢或技術訊號（如MACD黃金交叉）伴隨著高於平均的成交量時，可信度會大大提高，因為這代表有實際資金（通常是機構）在背後支持這個走勢。若缺乏成交量放大，看似利多的訊號可能只是雜訊，很快就會消退，這也是今日多隻高分股票暫未進場的原因。
